verdict.rationale: Lovable documents iterative refinement through chat: you can send follow-ups or corrections at any time to steer the work. Build mode shows every change as file diffs and summaries, and collaborators can work in separate drafts, which gives some visibility and isolation when changing a working app. However, nothing in the evidence shows protection against regressions, such as change-scoping guarantees, automatic testing, or a documented in-product rollback or restore of a prior working version. Missing for 10: documented safeguards against breaking existing functionality, in-product version restore or rollback, independent hands-on corroboration of stable iteration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can refine my app through follow-up prompts without breaking what already works

citations.quote: Send a follow-up, a correction, or a new idea at any time to steer the work
All modifications are visible through file diffs and summaries.
each of you can work in your own draft: a separate copy of the project with its own chat and preview.
